sources.title: M2M100 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: M2M100 is a multilingual encoder-decoder (seq-to-seq) model primarily intended for translation tasks. As the model is multilingual it expects the sequences in a certain format: A special language id token is used as prefix in both the source and target text.

sources.title: m2m100_418M: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview m2m100_418M is a multilingual encoder-decoder sequence-to-sequence model trained by facebook for many-to-many translation across 100 languages. The model can translate directly between 9,900 language direction pairs without requiring English as an intermediate language.
